name: coding-agent-orchestrator
description: Explicit-only Coding Agent Orchestrator (CAO) coordination in GUI Codex with official subagents. Activate for a coding objective only through a leading CAO or CAOで invocation, $coding-agent-orchestrator, explicit bundled-skill selection, or an explicit request to use this workflow; generic coding and bare attachment do not activate it.
keywords: コーディング-エージェント-オーケストレーター

interface.shortDescription: Explicit GUI coding orchestration with official subagents.
interface.longDescription: Coding Agent Orchestrator minimizes total coding wall-clock time by mapping dependencies and the critical path before the parent GUI Codex task dispatches work. Ready, independent, sufficiently large responsibilities whose benefit exceeds coordination and integration cost start in the same parallel wave without serial delay. Tightly coupled, dependency-blocked, overlapping, or too-small work stays parent-owned or ordered. The parent retains decomposition, authority, safety, worker routing, conflict resolution, integration, acceptance, and final reporting; each worker owns one exclusive complete output. State and verification remain minimal implementation support.
defaultPrompt: CAO map dependencies and the critical path for this coding objective, then parallelize ready independent work.
Use $coding-agent-orchestrator to minimize wall-clock time while keeping tightly coupled work parent-owned.
Continue the active Coding Agent Orchestrator workflow and integrate completed exclusive worker outputs.
